text: sed -n '14005,14060p' tests/codegen/io/streams.rs: / elephc answered silently, and two of the answers were wrong as well: `fwrite()` reported 0 /// bytes where php reports false, and `fflush()` reported success where php reports false. /// Every wording below was measured against php 8.5.6 on a wrapper declaring only `stream_open`; /// note that `feof()` alone also says what php assumed instead. `@` still silences all of them. /// /// `stream_read` is deliberately absent from this list: php 8.5.6 emits NO warning for a missing /// `stream_read`, measured with `stream_eof` present so the read is genuinely attempted. #[test] fn test_missing_wrapper_hooks_warn_by_class_and_method() { let out = compile_and_run_capture( r#"<?php class Bare { public $context; function stream_open($p, $m, $o, &$op) { $op = $p; return true; } } stream_wrapper_register("bare", "Bare"); $f = fopen("bare://x", "r+"); var_dump(fwrite($f, "abc")); var_dump(feof($f));
